note: Lane exec_gateway: the gateway (guards -> risk -> rate limits -> journal -> broker) graded through the one HTTP path that reaches it in the weekly book, /execute, in DRY_RUN with the replay Kite. Graded: the order journal byte for byte (every line's client_id = plan_id:symbol), the replay Kite's order/GTT call log (must stay EMPTY: DRY_RUN never reaches the broker), the DUPLICATE answer on a re-post (idempotency survives in the gateway's map), and the risk ledger. Never a live order.

cases.name: gateway: analyze the investing scan at 11:00
gateway: every order goes through the gateway in DRY_RUN and is journalled under plan_id:symbol
gateway: the same plan re-posted is DUPLICATE for every leg, nothing reaches the broker
gateway: a second plan from the sample scan mints different client ids
gateway: the second plan executes in DRY_RUN beside the first
gateway: confirm is case-sensitive, TRUE is not true (400, nothing sent)

gateway: a third plan at the close

gateway: the first plan, re-posted hours later, is 410 before the gateway is reached
